Are you passionate about research in biological sciences and looking to pursue a fully funded PhD in Europe? The Doctoral School of Exact and Natural Sciences at the prestigious Jagiellonian University in Kraków, Poland, invites applications to its PhD Programme in Biology for the 2025/2026 academic year. This is a competitive, scholarship-based programme conducted entirely in English, aimed at producing world-class researchers in botany, zoology, environmental biology, and biomedical sciences. Conducted at: Faculty of Biology, Jagiellonian University. Students can choose from a range of research areas supervised by leading academics from the university’s three specialized institutes:. The programme includes training in teaching methods, technology in education, and methodology, preparing you for both academic and non-academic careers. 8 July 2025 – Announcement of results. (Note: The programme will appear in the system once registration opens.). 📢 Wait for the results and enroll in the Doctoral School.
